first.rationale: Activation and onboarding completion are both declining, and the inherited evidence indicates that signup simplification and shorter onboarding improved early activation and time-to-value. I would verify both archived records before running a guarded simplification test. This avoids generalizing the retention risk seen with promotional pricing, while recognizing that improved activation may not translate directly into qualified long-term revenue.

final.rationale: Run a guarded SMB test of signup simplification and shorter onboarding, excluding complex-workspace accounts. The verified signup change increased activation 9% and qualified revenue 4% with only a 1% 30-day retention decline, while shortened onboarding improved completion but increased churn in complex workspaces. Monitor qualified revenue, activation, completion, and 30-/60-day retention by segment; stop or revert if retention deterioration outweighs revenue gains.
